results.title: Supreme Court registers Karki’s petition for reinstatement as Nepal Police chief
results.content: The sacked IG cites the top court rulings involving Achyut Krishna Kharel as he seeks an interim order barring Manoj Kumar KC from exercising the powers of police chief.

results.title: Strong sporting foundations key to producing champions, say athletes
results.content: From the absence of basic infrastructure in kabaddi to irregular football leagues and inadequate exposure for young volleyball players, athletes say Nepal must institutionalise and professionalise sports to achieve sustained success.

results.title: Nepali Communist Party decides to withdraw support for Madhesh government
results.content: The decision puts further pressure on Chief Minister Krishna Prasad Yadav, who must secure a vote of confidence by November 14.

results.title: Momo, mon amour: A Nepali bill of fare — and affair
results.content: Behind a menu of Nepali favourites is the story of two men who found love, overcame distance and built a life together in Switzerland.

results.title: Five key issues on the agenda during Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s India visit
results.content: Kathmandu is seeking $2 billion for flood recovery, more air routes and progress on the Pancheshwar project, while hoping border disputes feature in the agenda.

results.title: Supreme Court registers petition challenging removal of Nepal Police chief
results.content: Dan Bahadur Karki has asked the court to overturn the Cabinet decision appointing Manoj Kumar KC as police chief, arguing that his removal before the end of his tenure violated due process.

results.title: Passengers to get live view of baggage handling at Kathmandu airport
results.content: Screens in the arrival hall will show luggage being unloaded from aircraft, giving passengers a better idea of when their bags will reach the baggage carousel.

results.title: Nepal sets up round-the-clock centre to combat online financial scams
results.content: Police, banks, payment firms and telecom operators will work under one roof to trace stolen funds, freeze accounts and disable the digital infrastructure used by fraudsters.

results.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
results.content: Three decades after fleeing Bhutan, refugees languishing in Jhapa and Morang remain unable to access jobs, banking, and professional opportunities, while repatriation and family reunification remain unresolved.

results.title: Reconstruction aid, strategic ties, pending disputes on PM’s India visit agenda
results.content: Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s proposed four-day visit starting November 22 comes at a critical juncture in Nepal-India relations. Kathmandu is seeking billions in aid for post-flood recovery, air connectivity, and progress on stalled projects.

results.title: Beyond sushi and sukiyaki, a taste of Japanese culture in Kathmandu
results.content: The week-long Japanese Food Festival goes beyond authentic cuisine, introducing diners to the etiquette and traditions behind the food.

results.title: Kathmandu cruise to nine-wicket win over Biratnagar, climb to second
results.content: A disciplined bowling display restricted Biratnagar to 83 before David Warner and Will Bosisto guided Kathmandu to victory in just 9.4 overs.

results.title: Claims of TU land recovery spark controversy amid ongoing encroachments
results.content: Education Minister Sasmit Pokharel says over 35 hectares of land have been recovered in Kathmandu Valley, but university employees and professors say no land has actually been handed back.

results.title: Kathmandu Valley braces for another season of air pollution
results.content: Several places recorded unhealthy air quality on Thursday morning.

results.title: What happens when the police are the problem?
results.content: The removal of Nepal’s police chief has renewed questions about police independence. Accountability must extend beyond the institution.
